أحتمي (form VIII)
# أَحْتَمِي (ʔaḥtamī) /ʔaħ.ta.miː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# أَحْتَمِيَ (ʔaḥtamiya) /ʔaħ.ta.mi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
